resolution_notes: Settled rate_limits against the official Open Food Facts API docs (openfoodfacts.github.io). Docs publish explicit guidance: product queries ~100 req/min, search ~10 req/min, facet ~2 req/min, with User-Agent identification required and bulk use coordinated—not merely unpublished community tips. Other fields were undisputed and left null (keep original).
rate_limits: Product queries ~100 req/min; search ~10 req/min; facet ~2 req/min. User-Agent identification required. Bulk use needs coordination with Open Food Facts.
